abstract: OBJECTIVE: To assess the findings and complications of laparotomies for completely staging presumed early-stage ovarian cancer in patients who initial surgery was inadequate. METHODS: Records of 45 patients surgically restaged at our institution, after having been incompletely staged elsewhere, were reviewed for original operative reports, pathologic diagnoses, restaging procedures, operative results, and perioperative complications. RESULTS: Initial clinical staging was IA, 28; IB, three; IC, 12; IIA, one; IIB, one. Histologic distribution was as follows: invasive epithelial, 19 (42%); borderline epithelial, 16 (36%); germ cell tumor, seven (16%) had their disease reclassified to a more advanced stage. Of patients with borderline ovarian tumors, two, initially staged as IA, were restaged to IB and IC, and one was restaged from IIB to IIIA. Three patients with invasive epithelial adenocarcinoma were reclassified to a higher stage: one, with a presumed stage IC, poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma, to IIIB; one, with a stage IC, grade 2 mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, to IIIA; and a third, with a IIA, poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma, to IIIC. A patient with granulosa cell tumor, initially stages as IC, was restaged to IIB. Fifteen patients (33%) had complications after restaging surgery. Seven (16%) patients undergoing restaging laparotomy for presumed early ovarian cancer were reclassified to a higher stage, resulting in alteration of treatment for only on patient. In 18 patients with invasive cancer, the second operation confirmed the presence of low-risk stage IA/B disease, allowing adjuvant chemotherapy to be withheld. CONCLUSION: Although restaging laparotomies provide important prognostic information with minimal morbidity, they provide little benefit to those patients already requiring chemotherapy based on the original operative findings.
abstract_ja: 目的：初回の病期分類が不完全であった早期卵巣癌疑い症例において、完全な病期分類のための開腹術の所見と合併症を評価すること。方法：他施設で不完全に病期分類されていた患者45例の記録を後ろ向きに検討し、初回手術記録、病理診断、再病期分類手術、手術成績、術後合併症を確認した。結果：初回臨床病期はIA期28例、IB期3例、IC期12例、IIA期1例、IIB期1例であった。組織型の内訳は、浸潤性上皮性腫瘍19例（42%）、境界悪性上皮性腫瘍16例（36%）、胚細胞腫瘍7例（16%）であり、これらの病期は上位病期に再分類された。境界悪性卵巣腫瘍の患者では、IA期と判定された2例がIB期およびIC期に、IIB期の1例がIIIA期に再分類された。浸潤性上皮性腺癌の3例が上位病期に再分類された（IC期の低分化腺癌がIIIB期に、IC期グレード2の粘液性嚢胞腺癌がIIIA期に、IIA期の低分化腺癌がIIIC期に）。IC期の顆粒膜細胞腫の1例はIIB期に再分類された。再手術後に15例（33%）で合併症が生じた。再病期分類手術を受けた早期卵巣癌疑い患者のうち7例（16%）が上位病期に再分類されたが、治療が変更されたのは1例のみであった。浸潤癌の18例では、2回目の手術で低リスクのIA/B期病変が確認され、補助化学療法を省略できた。結論：再病期分類開腹術は最小限の罹患率で重要な予後情報を提供するが、初回手術所見に基づき既に化学療法を要する患者にはほとんど利益をもたらさない。
